figures.caption: Fig. 1. Overview of the workflow. (a) Flowchart of AnMBR experiment. (b) Modeling framework. T-R: reactor operation temperature; pH-in: influent pH; T-in: influent temperature; T-env: environment temperature; COD-in: influent chemical oxygen demand; OD: operation days; ORP: oxidation-reduction potential; HRTs: hydraulic retention times; MLSS: mixed liquor suspended solids; MLVSS: mixed liquor volatile suspended solids; FLMAL: the automated machine learning package; FCN: fully connected network; CNN: convolutional neural network; and DenseNet: densely connected convolutional network. Tree-based, permutation, and SHAP indicate different interpretation methods for machine learning models.

figures.caption: Fig. 5. Bland-Altman analysis of AutoML models. (a) Baseline, (b) add OD, (c) add OD, ORP, HRT, MLSS, and MLVSS, and (d) add all without OD in the feature.
